# Plan your node

This section provides guidance on designing your node, including key technical decisions such as choosing your node building style.

This section provides guidance on designing your node, including key technical decisions such as choosing your node building style.

When building a node, there are design choices you need to make before you start:

## In this section

* [Choose a node type](/connect/create-nodes/plan-your-node/choose-a-node-type): which node type you need to build.
* [Choose a node building style](/connect/create-nodes/plan-your-node/choose-a-node-building-style): which node building style to use.
* [Node UI design](/connect/create-nodes/plan-your-node/node-ui-design): UI design and UX principles.
* [Choose node file structure](/connect/create-nodes/plan-your-node/choose-node-file-structure): your node's file structure.
